First release of **ExplorerTabPlus**, a community-maintained continuation of [Explorer Tab Utility](https://github.com/w4po/ExplorerTabUtility) by [@w4po](https://github.com/w4po). It merges the community pull requests that were left open upstream after v2.5.0 (May 2025).

It is a **drop-in upgrade** over Explorer Tab Utility 2.5.0: same executable name (`ExplorerTabUtility.exe`), same settings folder (`%APPDATA%\ExplorerTabUtility`), same startup entry and installer ID. Your settings and hotkey profiles are kept.

## Added

- **Bookmarks** — save the current tab as a bookmark, open bookmarks from a bookmark-bar popup (click: current tab, Ctrl: new tab, Shift: new window), and organize them in a bookmark manager with folders, drag-and-drop, cut/copy/paste, search and import/export. New hotkey actions `BookmarkSave`, `BookmarkNavigate`, `BookmarkManage`. ([#140](https://github.com/w4po/ExplorerTabUtility/pull/140) by [@NeedJustWord](https://github.com/NeedJustWord))
- **Multi-language UI** — English and Simplified Chinese, selectable in the main window; language files in the `Languages` folder. ([#131](https://github.com/w4po/ExplorerTabUtility/pull/131), [#140](https://github.com/w4po/ExplorerTabUtility/pull/140) by [@NeedJustWord](https://github.com/NeedJustWord))

## Fixed

- `ObjectDisposedException` on shutdown caused by disposing shell objects twice. ([#139](https://github.com/w4po/ExplorerTabUtility/pull/139) by [@taroyamadax](https://github.com/taroyamadax))
- Explorer windows becoming unopenable while Window Hook is on: stale COM entries are cleaned up, shell objects are rebuilt after sleep/hibernate, and a window is kept visible if converting it to a tab fails. ([#137](https://github.com/w4po/ExplorerTabUtility/pull/137) by [@youncyb](https://github.com/youncyb))
- Tab navigation event handlers are always detached (including on timeout/failure) and selection no longer runs inside Explorer's COM callback; related to the stuck loading cursor. ([#142](https://github.com/w4po/ExplorerTabUtility/pull/142) by [@yueyangcode](https://github.com/yueyangcode))
- The requested file selection ("Show in folder", `explorer /select`) is preserved when a window is converted to a tab or an existing tab is reused. ([#144](https://github.com/w4po/ExplorerTabUtility/pull/144) by [@aiolosking](https://github.com/aiolosking))

## Changed (fork maintenance)

- The in-app updater checks this repository's releases instead of upstream.
- The About page project link and installer URLs point to this repository; developer and sponsor links still credit w4po.
- Release pipeline rebuilt without the upstream SignPath signing service; CI builds both target frameworks on every change.
- Removed the upstream WinGet/Chocolatey publishing workflows (they publish under upstream's package IDs).

## Which file should I download?

- **Not sure?** Use `ExplorerTabUtility_v2.6.0_Setup.exe`. It picks the right build for your CPU and offers to install the .NET 9 Desktop Runtime, or falls back to .NET Framework 4.8.1.
- **Portable zip:**
  - `..._Net9.0_FrameworkDependent.zip` needs the [.NET 9 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/9.0).
  - `..._NetFW4.8.1.zip` works out of the box on Windows 11.
  - `x64` for most PCs, `arm64` for Windows on ARM, `x86` only for 32-bit Windows.

> [!WARNING]
> These builds are **not code-signed**. Windows SmartScreen may warn "Windows protected your PC" — choose *More info* → *Run anyway*. Some antivirus products may flag the keyboard/mouse hooks as suspicious; this is a false positive and the source is in this repository.

Thanks to [@w4po](https://github.com/w4po) for the original project and to every contributor above.
